title: Agent Certificate v0 Per-Claim Payload Types
description: ONE EXPLICIT PAYLOAD TYPE PER REGISTERED CLAIM ID. These seven bounded payload shapes remain available as isolated future-evolution records, but current v0 ClaimV0 emission is deliberately limited to D2 and G1 tier 1. B1, C1, F1, and G3 are unprintable until their post-finalization verifier evidence is independently registered; REG1 is pending matrix registration and unprintable. The payload schemas remain so a future registered release can test their shapes without weakening the current emission gate. No user-controlled free text is representable.

ClaimPayloadV0.description: Discriminated union of the seven v0 payload types; the claim_id const inside each branch is the discriminator, so exactly one branch can validate.

ClaimPayloadB1V0.description: Future registered payload shape for B1. Current v0 ClaimV0 emission rejects B1 because its PASS verifier is not independently available until the manifest/signature/audit cycle is finalized. If later registered, the claim is limited to 'the issuer signed this seal statement', not sealed-history integrity. Params bind the named seal and statement digest only.

ClaimPayloadREG1V0.description: Future registered payload shape for REG1, the registry commitment receipt extension. REG1 is pending V4-matrix registration and is unprintable in current v0 ClaimV0. The bounded shape retains the conservative receipt scope: bytes, identifier, and server-recorded time only; no truth, authorship, completeness, counts, date buckets, or timestamps cross.

ClaimPayloadC1V0.description: Future registered payload shape for C1. Current v0 ClaimV0 emission rejects C1 because its PASS verifier depends on the finalized manifest/signature/audit cycle. The artifact-scoped sentence remains distinct from the prohibited global unsupported-claims form. Params pin the compiler and register/catalog digests.

ClaimPayloadD2V0.description: Claim D2 — per-run client privacy-mode attestation plus 'the precisely scoped SDK e97b030f strace witness' (C6 Ruling 5, committee-gated adapter). 'D2 is the sole runtime-witnessed row in the supplied evidence, and even it must remain precisely scoped to the attestation mode and SDK witness identified.' The witness does not carry to other refs: it 'must be rerun at the new pinned implementation ref' (C1 Ruling 4) — hence the mandatory full-SHA sdk_ref pin. Offline zero-egress wording beyond the exact attested run or pinned SDK witness scope is prohibited (merged prohibited claim 16).

workload_class.description: Closed workload-class vocabulary. The only witnessed class today is the mock-mode grid-search shape with no integrations, no analytics clients, and no Langfuse (the truth-test scope, carried verbatim as the class definition).

ClaimPayloadF1V0.description: Future registered payload shape for F1 (matrix issuer-signature validity; the rulings' alias was D5). Current v0 ClaimV0 emission rejects F1 because its PASS verifier can run only after finalizing the manifest/signature/audit cycle. The payload intentionally has no self-referential manifest digest; it binds scheme, key, and ring references for a later registered release.

ClaimPayloadG1V0.description: Claim G1 — client evidence-manifest commitment (C6 Ruling 5 core kernel: exact client signature bindings). The commitment proves possession at commit time, never completeness; the only registered scheme is secret-blinded (C1 Ruling 4 binding rule).

ClaimPayloadG3V0.description: Future registered payload shape for G3. Current v0 ClaimV0 emission rejects G3 because its PASS verifier can run only after finalizing the manifest/signature/audit cycle. The shape binds only the opaque client key reference (and optional enrollment digest); it does not assert server truth.
